```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(Matrix)

library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)

data_storage_folder = "../../../Data/ExtData/Yue_scRNA_IMO"

```

# Overview

## Sample description

```{r, message=F}
gse <- getGEO("GSE210991", GSEMatrix = T)
pd <- pData(gse[[1]])

ed <- pd[, c("title", "geo_accession","culture condition:ch1","tissue/cell type:ch1", "copy number profile:ch1")]
colnames(ed) <- c("title","geo_accession","culture_condition","tissue_type","CNV")
ed$culture_condition <- gsub("Culture condition: ","", ed$culture_condition)
ed$Condition <- paste0(gsub("Human ","",ed$tissue_type), ",", 
                       ifelse(ed$culture_condition == "In ultra-low binding plate with standard gastric organoid medium","+Wnt",
                              ifelse(grepl("without Wnt-3A",ed$culture_condition), "-Wnt","+Wnt")) )

```


```{r}
kable(ed)
```

# Data import

```{r}
mat_files = list.files(path="../../../Data/ExtData/Yue_scRNA_IMO/Raw/", pattern = "*count.txt.gz", recursive = T, full.names = T)

sample_ids = unlist(Map(function(x) sapply(strsplit(basename(x),"_"), `[`, 1 ) , mat_files))
names(mat_files) = sample_ids

all_sample_data = list()
for (n in sample_ids) {
  ifile=mat_files[n]
  # header_line = as.character(fread(ifile, header=F, nrows=1)[1,])
  tmp = fread(ifile, sep="\t", header=T)
  tmp_mat = as.matrix(tmp[,2:ncol(tmp)])
  # colnames(tmp_mat) = header_line
  rownames(tmp_mat) = tmp$gene
  all_sample_data[[n]] = CreateSeuratObject(as(tmp_mat, "sparseMatrix"), project=n)
  rm(tmp, tmp_mat)
  gc()
}

all_ge_data_raw = merge(all_sample_data[[1]], all_sample_data[2:length(all_sample_data)])
rm(all_sample_data)
gc(verbose=F)


all_ge_data_raw@meta.data$sample_label <- ed[match(all_ge_data_raw$orig.ident, ed$geo_accession), "title"]
all_ge_data_raw@meta.data$Condition <- ed[match(all_ge_data_raw$orig.ident, ed$geo_accession), "Condition"]
all_ge_data_raw@meta.data$tissue_type <- ed[match(all_ge_data_raw$orig.ident, ed$geo_accession), "tissue_type"]
all_ge_data_raw@meta.data$CNV <- ed[match(all_ge_data_raw$orig.ident, ed$geo_accession), "CNV"]
```

## Cells per sample (unfiltered)

```{r}
table(all_ge_data_raw$sample_label)
table(all_ge_data_raw$Condition)
```

```{r}
meta <- all_ge_data_raw@meta.data
par(mar=c(12,4,4,1))
barplot(table(meta$sample_label), las=2, ylab="Cell count")
```

### Thresholds for numbers of detected genes and percentage of mitochondrial genes

```{r}
hist(log10(meta$nCount_RNA), 1000, main="Log10 Number of reads per cell"); abline(v=log10(c(400,5500)), col="red")
hist(log10(meta$nFeature_RNA), 1000, main="Log10 Number of detected genes per cell"); abline(v=log10(c(200,5500)), col="red")
hist(all_ge_data_raw$percent_mito, 1000, main="Percent mitochondrial RNA"); abline(v=30, col="red")
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
ggplot(all_ge_data_raw@meta.data) + geom_density(aes(x=nFeature_RNA) ) + facet_wrap(~sample_label) + ggtitle("nFeature_RNA") + geom_vline(xintercept = c(200,8000), col="red")
tmp <- all_ge_data_raw@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_label) %>%
  summarise(perc_high = round(sum(percent_mito > 15)/length(percent_mito),3))
ggplot(all_ge_data_raw@meta.data) + geom_density(aes(x=percent_mito) ) + facet_wrap(~sample_label) + ggtitle("percent_mito") + geom_vline(xintercept = c(15), col="red") +  geom_text(x = 15, y = 0.2, aes(label = paste0(">15%: ", perc_high)), data = tmp)
```


# Filtering 

We exclude cells with less than 200 detected genes, those with > 5000 detected genes (possible doublets) and those with clear signs of cellular stress (percentage of mitochondrial RNA > 30%). 

```{r}
feature_low = 200
feature_high = 8000
max_mito = 15

all_ge_data_raw = AddMetaData(all_ge_data_raw, (all_ge_data_raw$nFeature_RNA > feature_low & all_ge_data_raw$nFeature_RNA < feature_high & all_ge_data_raw$percent_mito < max_mito), col.name="CellFilterKeep")

ribo.genes <- grepl(pattern = "^RP[SL]|^Rp[sl]", x = rownames(x = all_ge_data_raw@assays$RNA))
mito.genes <- grepl(pattern = "^MT-|^mt-", x = rownames(x = all_ge_data_raw@assays$RNA))

selected_c <- WhichCells(all_ge_data_raw, expression = CellFilterKeep )
selected_f <- rownames(all_ge_data_raw)[ Matrix::rowSums(all_ge_data_raw) >= 2 & !(ribo.genes | mito.genes)]
```



## Number of removed/kept cells per condition

```{r}
m = table(all_ge_data_raw$sample_label, ifelse(all_ge_data_raw$CellFilterKeep, "Keep","Remove") )
m
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}

mm_ts = reshape2::melt(m)
colnames(mm_ts) = c("Group","Status","Count")
mm_ts$Status = factor(mm_ts$Status, levels=c("Remove","Keep"))

ggplot(mm_ts, aes(x=Group, fill=Status,y=Count)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=14), legend.text = element_text(size=16)) + xlab("") + geom_hline(yintercept = 1000) + ggtitle("Total number of kept and filtered cells per condition (horizontal line = 1000 cells)")

#barplot(t(m), las=2, col=c("green","red"))
```



```{r}
all_ge_data_filtered <- subset(all_ge_data_raw, features=selected_f, cells=selected_c)

dim(all_ge_data_filtered)
```

Raw and filtered data is saved to individual files *All_Raw_scData.Rdata* and *All_Raw_scData.Rdata* in folder `r data_storage_folder` .

```{r}
#save(all_ge_data_raw, ed,  file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "All_Raw_scData.Rdata"))
save(all_ge_data_filtered, ed, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "All_Filtered_scData.Rdata"), compress=T)
```
